INSERT INTO sheet_note_counts (sheet_id, key, value)
             SELECT id, k.key, k.value
             FROM sheets, (VALUES ('total', 1000), ('tap', 500), ('hold', 100),
                                  ('slide', 200), ('touch', 150), ('break', 50))
                          AS k(key, value)
             WHERE sheet_expr = 'example|dx|master'
